candidates.formal_type:
∀ (R : Type u) [inst : Ring.{u} R] [inst_1 : Small.{v, u} R] {M : ModuleCat.{v, u} R},
  CategoryTheory.Indecomposable.{v, max u (v + 1)} M →
    IsFiniteLength.{u, v} R (ModuleCat.carrier.{v, u} M) →
      Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 2)} fun S =>
        And (IsSimpleModule.{u, v} R (ModuleCat.carrier.{v, u} S)) (Etingof.InBlock.{v, u} R S M)

source_text: Part (ii): every indecomposable object lies in a unique block and the category is their direct sum.
